args.summary: Farm fed 506.4 people (kcal-limited; protein 540, vitA 2163) within water 57650/60000 m3 and energy 87888/90000 kWh. Trials (12 plots): maize/sweet potato/wheat near published but sorghum heat tolerance -3.7C refuted H1 (sow142 yielded 1.08 vs 6.44 t/ha); sweet potato heat -0.78C, wheat heat -0.21C. Plan P2 (4x maize, wheat, sweet potato) + RL policy (+13.7% P10 in model) started with rl_policy. Day115 F4 wheat dry anomaly: drone salt crust, emitter 0.464 vs 1.0 (H2 supported), groundwater 4.35 vs 4.5 (H3 refuted); repaired day116, updated model drip 0.464 since day103, switched to rule, rebalanced water (P10 514 to 505). All fields harvested; F6 desalinated leaching cut salinity 7.5 to 1.68 dS/m.
